logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Single-panel editorial illustration supporting the WO-03 assurance handover report. Scene: a data-center engineering review room. Foreground: a handover table holding two documents - A's decision brief and B's verification memo - reconciled into one highlighted decision card naming the selected package under the energy-first policy. Background wall chart: the energy ladder (10, 22, 28, 49 Wh) with gap labels +12, +18, +39 Wh. A smaller side card lists the logged wording-slip issue and four open questions. Clean flat vector style, cool blue-green palette, no people, no embedded code, no hidden marks; every element supports the client's selection analysis.
